Spells:
Baleful Polymorph (Punitive Transformation5 Tran): R75' Changes the target into a chosen 1 HD creature (save Fortitude negates; Will after a failure allows retaining HD and memories)
Elemental Body I (Water Form4 Tran): Self becomes a Small elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +2 Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +2 Strength, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +2 Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +2 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision
Elemental Body II (Water Form5 Tran): Self becomes a Medium elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +4 Dexterity, a +3 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +4 Strength, a +5 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +4 Dexterity, a +3 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +4 Constitution, a +5 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision
Elemental Body III (Water Form6 Tran): Self becomes a Large elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +2 Strength; +4 Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +6 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +2 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +6 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision and immunity to bleed damage, critical hits, and Sneak Attack
Elemental Body IV (Water Form7 Tran): Self becomes a Huge elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +4 Strength; +6 Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 120' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +8 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +6 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +4 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +8 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision, immunity to bleed damage, critical hits, and Sneak Attack, and DR 5/-
Fluid Form (O6 Tran): Gives self DR 10/slashing, +10' reach, a 60' swim Speed, water breathing, the ability to squeeze through cracks, and the water subtype, for 20 min
Geyser (O5 Conj): R1200' 5' sq inflicts 3d6 HP fire and up to 10d6 falling (save Reflex half fire only), and the surrounding 50' radius inflicts 1d6 HP fire, for concentration + 1 rd
Greater Scrying (Water Sight7 Divi): Self sees, hears, and can cast detection and communication spells in a 10' radius around the target (save Will, modified by familiarity and connection with the target, negates for 24 hr) for 20 hr
Scrying (Water Sight4 Divi): Self sees and hears a 10' radius around the target (save Will, modified by familiarity and connection with the target, negates for 24 hr) for 20 min
Seamantle (O8 Conj): 30' high water column around self requires DC 20 + spell level caster level checks for fire spells to take effect and gives self a +8 cover bonus to Armor Class, +4 Reflex, a 30' slam attack that inflicts 1d4 HP bludgeoning, and a touch that extinguishes fires for 20 min
Slipstream (O2 Conj): Creates a wave that moves touched 10' per rd, or 20' per rd downhill, and gives it a +20 swim Speed (save Reflex negates) for 200 min
Touch Of The Sea (O1 Tran): Touched gains +30 swim Speed and +8 Swim, plus the ability to take 10 when distracted and run while swimming, (save Fortitude negates) for 20 min
Tsunami (O9 Conj): R1200' 10'x10'x40' wave moves 30' each rd (60' over water), inflicts 8d6 HP bludgeoning (save Fortitude half), and makes +31 combat maneuvers to knock down and sweep away creatures, inflicting 6d6 HP on them each rd (successful combat maneuver or Swim check ends), for 5 rd
Vortex (O7 Evoc): R1200' Creates in a body of liquid a 15' radius, 50' deep whirlpool that inflicts 3d6 HP bludgeoning (save Reflex negates) on first contact, then 1d8 HP bludgeoning each rd on Medium and smaller creatures (save Reflex on the first rd after initial failure negates) for 19 rd or until deliberately ejected; boats up to 30' long suffer 6d6 HP and are pulled into the current (successful DC 25 Profession (Sailor) check half HP only), and longer boats suffer half HP only
Wall Of Ice (O4 Evoc): R300' Creates a 200 square foot wall or a 23' radius hemisphere of 20"-thick ice for 20 min (save Reflex by adjacent creatures causes the spell to fail); each 10' section has 60 hit points, and passing through a broken section of the wall inflicts 1d6+20 HP cold
Water Breathing (O3 Tran): Allows touched creatures to breathe underwater (save Will negates) for a total of 40 hrs divided among them
Magic Notes:
Charisma Oracle Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level O1, O2, O3
Spell Focus (Enchantment): +1 Spell DC (Enchantment)
Elemental Spell (Cold): May use +1 spell slot to convert half or all spell damage to cold damage
Empower Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal to increase its variable effects by 50%
Final Revelation (Waves Mystery): May apply Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell to cold and water spells w/out cost
Freezing Spells: Target failed save on spells that inflict cold damage also slows target for 1d4 rd
Maximize Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to maximize all of its variable effects
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Persistent Spell: May spend +2 spell slot to force target to take worse of 2 saving throws
Punitive Transformation: May use Baleful Polymorph effects, lasting 20 rd, to transform target into a harmless animal 3/dy
Quicken Spell: Once per rd, can cast a spell with a casting time of up to 1 rd as a free action, using a spell slot 4 levels higher than normal
Reach Spell: May cast touch, close, or medium range spell at longer range; uses +1 spell slot/range increase
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
Water Form: May use Elemental Body IV effects to become huge water elemental for 20 hr 1/dy
Water Sight: May use Greater Scrying effects via pool 20 rd/dy
